{{Quote|&hellip;treasury ship ''Walker'' and Corvette escort attacked and several damaged by six Rebel X-wings in Fakir sector&hellip;|An extract from a report authored by the [[Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War]]|<ref name="SWS" />}}
The '''''Walker''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was transiting through the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] with a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] escort when it was attacked by six [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. The ''Walker'' and its escort were severely damaged in the assault.
